result.instructions: Tools for Zenamu, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What classes do we have next week, and which are canceled?"; "Which lecturers are teaching the workshops this month?"; "Show me the clients with the lowest entry-pass balances.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zenamu data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenamu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenamu_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenamu_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zenamu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenamu_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: List the published schedule of the studio for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, studio time zone, max 366 days). Returns classes and course sessions (read eventType), with times, lecturerIds, locationId, pricing options and seat capacity when requested. Canceled events are included with isCanceled=true. Zenamu API: GET /v1/classes.

dateFrom.description: First day of the range, inclusive.

dateTo.description: Last day of the range, inclusive.

placeIds.description: Comma-separated place IDs. Use -1 for online classes.

lecturerIds.description: Comma-separated lecturer IDs, as the docs describe them. The IDs in class results are opaque strings: pass them as returned.

labelIds.description: Comma-separated label (tag) IDs. Matches any listed label.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Unset returns every match in the range.

includeCapacity.description: Add live seat counts (more expensive on the API side). Use only when showing availability.

tools.name: zenamu_list_workshops
tools.title: List workshops
tools.description: List the studio's public workshops (standalone events such as retreats and intensives) for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, max 366 days). Each workshop has its own address and pricing. Canceled workshops are excluded. Zenamu API: GET /v1/workshops.

dateFrom.description: First day of the range, inclusive.

dateTo.description: Last day of the range, inclusive.

lecturerIds.description: Comma-separated lecturer IDs, as the docs describe them. The IDs in class results are opaque strings: pass them as returned.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Unset returns every match in the range.

includeCapacity.description: Add live seat counts (more expensive on the API side). Use only when showing availability.

tools.name: zenamu_list_lecturers
tools.title: List lecturers
tools.description: List the studio's lecturers with name, photo and bio. Use it to turn the lecturerIds from classes and workshops into names. Contact details are never returned. Zenamu API: GET /v1/lecturers.

includeInactive.description: Also return lecturers who are no longer active (useful for past events).

tools.name: zenamu_list_places
tools.title: List places
tools.description: List the studio's physical locations with name and address. Use it to turn the locationId from classes into an address. Archived places are excluded. Zenamu API: GET /v1/places.

tools.name: zenamu_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List every active client of the studio with contact details, credit and entry-pass balances, pass balances per pass group, make-up sessions and booking totals. Returns personal data. Needs the secret key and the Ultimate plan. Archived and blocked clients are excluded. Zenamu API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: zenamu_list_pass_groups
tools.title: List pass groups
tools.description: List the studio's entry-pass groups (active and archived) with their id, name and state. Use an id as passGroupId when granting passes. Needs the secret key and the Ultimate plan. Zenamu API: GET /v1/pass-groups.

tools.name: zenamu_grant_credits
tools.title: Grant credits to a client
tools.description: WRITE: adds credits to one client's account and returns the new balance. Changes what the client owes or holds. Not idempotent: a retry after an unclear failure can grant twice, so check the balance first with zenamu_list_clients. sendEmail=true emails the client. Zenamu API: POST /v1/clients/{clientId}/credits.

clientId.description: Client numeric id, from zenamu_list_clients (field `id`, not `_id`).

count.description: Number of credits or entries to add.

validityTimeValue.description: How many validityTimeUnit periods the grant stays valid, from now.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example CZK or EUR.

price.description: Amount the client paid. Use 0 for a gift or reward.

sendEmail.description: Required. true emails the client about the grant; false grants silently.

tools.name: zenamu_grant_passes
tools.title: Grant entry passes to a client
tools.description: WRITE: adds entry passes to one client's account in a pass group and returns the new balance in that group. Changes what the client holds. Not idempotent: a retry after an unclear failure can grant twice, so check the balance first with zenamu_list_clients. Omit passGroupId for the studio's default group. sendEmail=true emails the client. Zenamu API: POST /v1/clients/{clientId}/passes.

clientId.description: Client numeric id, from zenamu_list_clients (field `id`, not `_id`).

count.description: Number of credits or entries to add.

validityTimeValue.description: How many validityTimeUnit periods the grant stays valid, from now.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example CZK or EUR.

price.description: Amount the client paid. Use 0 for a gift or reward.

passGroupId.description: Pass group id from zenamu_list_pass_groups. Omit for the default group.

sendEmail.description: Required. true emails the client about the grant; false grants silently.
